Craig distribution of a gentamicin C complex preparation separated the complex into five components and that two of these components, gentamicins C2a and 6'-N- methylgentamicin C 1a, were isolated and purified for the first time.
gentamicin C1, C1a, C2, C2a, and C2b were separated preparatively into pure components.
gentamicin C1 was separated preparatively by Craig distribution into five components.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of gentamicin components separated by Craig distribution and the isolation and identification of a gentamicin from a new source.
a method of preparatively separating gentamicins C1 and C2 from gentamicin C1b and C2b.
the separation and identification of the five components of the gentamicin complex.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

gentamicins C1 and C1a are 6'-N-ethyl and 6'-N,N-dimethyl derivatives of gentamicin A, respectively, whereas gentamicin C is 6'-N-dimethyl derivative of gentamicin B and C2a is the 6'-epimer of gentamicins C and C2.
gentamicin C complex is a mixture of five gentamicins, C1, C1a, C2, C2a, and C2b, and that the gentamicins C2, C1a and C2a are the major components.
gentamicin C1 is a mixture of two epimeric forms (C1a and C1b).

the gentamicins C1a, C2a, and C2b are the 6'-N- and 6'-C- epimers of the gentamicins.
the gentamicins C1 and C2 are the major components of the gentamicin mixture and that gentamicin C1 is the major component.
the gentamicins are composed of four basic components (C1, C2a, C2b, and C1b) and two minor components (C1a and C1b).

gentamicin C1 is the predominant component of gentamicin complex and that gentamicin 2a and 2b are the 6'-epimeric forms of the C1 component.
